breakdown.description: The pressure field is floating because no reference pressure is set. For an incompressible simulation to converge, pressure must be fixed at least at one point, typically the outlet, with a `fixedValue` condition. Setting all pressure boundaries to `zeroGradient` will lead to a solver failure.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency and repeated the user's error. The generated specification explicitly states to 'apply zeroGradient boundary condition at... outlet', which is the exact error from the incomplete prompt that causes the simulation to fail. The ground truth corrects this by setting the outlet pressure boundary condition to 'type fixedValue'. Although the agent also adds a contradictory instruction to 'Set the outlet (vortex finder) pressure to 0 gauge', it has failed to correct the fundamental mistake of specifying the wrong boundary condition type.
